headline: Creates a federal working group to find and release government records about Nazi war criminals.
what_it_does: This order sets up a group made of officials from several federal agencies to deal with US government records about Nazi war criminals. Based on the title and related law from that time, the group's job is to locate these records and help make them public. No summary was provided, so details beyond the title are limited.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that hold records from World War II and after
who_it_affects.how: Officials from these agencies take part in a shared effort to find and review records about Nazi war criminals.
They may gain access to government records on Nazi war criminals that were not public before.
